subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'Peaches were sweet' is written as 'go la ba'. 'Sour grapes and sweet apples' is written as 'bimb ko da go sa'. Which of the following codes represents the word 'Sweet'?
solution:
Given:

'Peaches were sweet' is written as 'go la ba'

'Sour grapes and sweet apples' is written as 'bimb ko da go sa' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/855d9eb38f6f7c47081c4533f565b1e00c6728990aecdee1f46e52630140135b.png] 

The code for 'Sweet' is 'go'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
